image_description: A side-profile view of a Common Wombat standing on rocky ground near the entrance of a burrow. The animal has a stocky, barrel-shaped body covered in coarse, greyish-brown fur. Its head is broad and blunt with small eyes and rounded ears. The limbs are short and sturdy, supporting a low center of gravity. The background consists of dark earth/rock and some green vegetation.
